description: Talleres Aeronáuticos Nacionales Autorizados por la Autoridad de Aeronáutica Civil Dic 2021 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad de aeronautica civil de Panamá. Listado de talleres aeronáuticos con nombre de empresa, certificado y base de operaciones. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad de aeronautica civil de Panamá . Its tags are Logistica, Transporte. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2022-02-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
